messages:
deploy-bot: rolling out release/api-v2 -> gateway-canary @ 5% (header-gate: X-Api-Version=2). runbook: /runbooks/v2-rollout. will stream logs to #eng-releases.

jamie: quick question — do we have a compatibility story for clients that don't send the new header? mobile still on v1 builds.

alisha: yep — mobile doesn't set X-Api-Version yet. gateway currently routes to v2 only when header present, otherwise falls back to v1, but some clients send generic UA that looks like web, so risk of misrouting exists.

jamie: ok. can we temporary-pin a UA-based rule so MobileApp/* always hits v1?

alisha: we can. propose this phased plan:
1) immediate: apply UA pin for MobileApp -> v1 to avoid breaking active sessions.
2) internal canary (team/internal users) 10% for 30m.
3) widen to 20% external for 6h if stable.
4) gradual increase after 24h.

santiago: suggested rollout safety thresholds (we should enforce automatic hold/rollback):
- 5xx rate > 1.0% over 5m -> hold and notify 
- error spike (client 4xx auth regressions) > 0.8% -> immediate canary rollback
- p95 latency > 350ms -> auto-hold

emily: I'll update release notes + support blurb. change window request: Monday 23:00 PST (low traffic). if everyone agrees I'll publish.

noah: oncall coverage for first 2 hours. I'll watch the deploy channel and metrics. set pager thresholds to 1xx above baseline.

alisha: pin command ready. to apply UA pin (ops-only):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://ops.internal/api/v1/pins" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"route":"gateway","pin_version":"v1","filter":"User-Agent:MobileApp*","reason":"protect mobile clients during v2 rollout"}'
```

alisha: to remove pin: `curl -X DELETE https://ops.internal/api/v1/pins/{pin_id}` or use /ops pin remove gateway MobileApp.

jamie: also add a short rollback playbook in the runbook: commands to pin back to v1, how to abort the canary, and how to re-open. add steps for support to notify customers in case of client-facing changes.

sre-bot: pre-deploy checks: infra-health=OK, kvcache=OK, gateway-procs=green, disk>20% free. no DB migrations.

deploy-bot: applying UA pin now. will start internal 10% once pin acked. logs: https://logs.internal/streams/1909876543

emily: publishing release notes draft to #marketing-drafts and /docs changelog. will include note about header-based opt-in and mobile pin.

jamie: agreed on Monday 23:00 PST, internal 30m, external 6h canary. circuit-breaker thresholds as santiago suggested. if any of the thresholds hit, ops will flip the manual rollback pin.

noah: +1. I'll escalate to SRE if alarms trigger. tagging @pager-duty. :eyes:

santiago: one more: please set the header-gate timeout to 2s for backend calls during canary to avoid backlog.

alisha: done. gate timeout patched in config and baked into canary.

deploy-bot: canary started (internal 10%). will report metrics at +5/15/30m.

jamie: thanks. i'll monitor client errors and surfacing regressions. if nothing odd in 30m, widen to 20% external. :thumbsup:

emily: noted, support blurb and FAQ ready.

sre-bot: live metrics: p95=120ms, 5xx=0.03%. no anomalies at T+10m.

deploy-bot: T+30m check-in: internal canary stable. ready to widen to 20% external upon @alisha sign-off.

alisha: widening now. will keep pin in place for MobileApp UA until mobile ships header.

jamie: decision: keep UA pin until mobile client rolls header, track metrics daily, review in next release retro.

noah: closing the loop — I'll hand off to next oncall at +2h.
